title: New emphasis/lane demo directives truncate pipe ids u64->u32 with no range check — an id >= 2^32 silently targets the wrong live pipe
detail: parse_uint returns u64; u32(fid) truncates mod 2^32. A mistyped id like 4294967297 becomes pipe 1 and edits a live pipe silently — bypassing the .Missing_Pipe rejection the spec's I/O matrix promises for bad pipe args.
recommended_fix: Range-check before the cast: reject fid > u32::MAX with the existing parse-error path, or parse with strconv.parse_u32 so an oversized id fails loudly at parse.

title: intent_apply_tick_raw multiplies unbounded at_ms by logic_hz — an i64 overflow wraps and silently fires the command at tick 1
detail: at_ms is parsed unbounded. at_ms > i64::MAX/20 (≈4.6e17 ms) overflows the multiply, wraps negative, clamps to 0, so the command applies at tick 1 instead of failing loudly. New proc replicates the base ms*hz/1000 convention.
recommended_fix: Bound at_ms at parse (reject values beyond the run duration, or cap at i64::MAX/logic_hz) so a mistyped huge time fails loudly instead of wrapping to tick 1.
